title: OSPFv2 Neighbor Adjacency Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose, isolate, and repair common OSPFv2 neighbor adjacency failures including Hello and Dead timer mismatches, Area ID errors, and missing network advertisements.
learning_objectives: Identify the mandatory operational parameters that must match for two OSPFv2 routers to achieve FULL adjacency
Diagnose Hello and Dead interval timer mismatches using show ip ospf interface and debug output
Troubleshoot OSPF Area ID mismatches between transit router interfaces across a point-to-point link
Identify missing network statements that prevent LAN prefixes from being injected into the OSPF Link-State Database
Configure appropriate passive interfaces to protect access subnets while maintaining WAN neighbor adjacencies
Verify complete SPF route convergence and end-to-end data plane reachability across a multi-router topology

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise OSPFv2 troubleshooting curriculum guide aligned with Cisco CCNA exam topic 3.2
